Incremental policy ruleset chunk from file 'Test1-NL.md' (1-based global rule indices 1–10).

Rules in this chunk:
1. A refund request is valid if and only if it is initiated within 30 days of the original transaction date.
2. ​A full refund requires the item to be returned in its original, unopened packaging.
3. ​If an item is verified as defective upon delivery, the original packaging requirement is waived.
4. ​All refund requests must be accompanied by a verifiable proof of purchase.
5. ​Digital goods and personalized items are strictly non-refundable.
6. ​Opened, non-defective items are subject to a 15% restocking fee deducted from the refund total.
7. ​Approved refunds shall be credited exclusively to the original payment method.
8. ​If the original payment method is inaccessible, the refund will default to non-transferable store credit.
9. ​Original shipping and handling charges are non-refundable unless the return is necessitated by a merchant error or defect.
10. ​Any refund total exceeding $500 requires explicit authorization from a managerial tier before execution.
